span.p: ② DMA Transfer to Host RX Ring Buffer

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 640px; text-align: center;

span.p:
③ eBPF XDP Hook (Driver Level)
ctx->data ▶ [ Ethernet Header ] [ IPv4 Header ] [ L4 TCP/UDP ] [ Payload ] ◀ ctx->data_end

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 640px; text-align: center;

span.p:
④ - Verifier Bounds Checking: ((void *)(hdr + 1) > data_end)
- Update Per-CPU Protocol Counter (Lock-Free)
- Lookup Source IP in BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH (blocked_ips)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 640px; text-align: center;

span.p:
XDP_DROP
(Zero Memory Overhead!)
- Instantly drops packet
- Increments drop counter
- Packet never touches OS
